'''Thant & Sons, Starshipwrights''' was a large company that specialized in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Starshipwright|repair and modification]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was located in the [[Lola Curich Starport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]].
